$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: rc.6 prepare PR (founder-approved 2026-10-08): bunx changeset version bumps the fixed group to 1.0.0-rc.6, consuming the adapter-path-render404-workaround.md and next-16-3-8-security.md changesets landed on main. This PR touches no credential-harness file per frozenFileSet() (derived against this PR's merge base): the only frozen file in its diff is .github/compat-credential-ref.json itself, to introduce this marker and its own publishedBytesBumpMarker, so the marker is scoped to that one path. The harness changes for rc.6 already landed on main under the earlier marker, which exempts nothing here. rcTag does NOT move here; that is a later PR once the v1.0.0-rc.6 tag is actually pushed. Remove this marker once merged.

$publishedBytesBumpMarkerComment: #1663 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/published-bytes-freeze-guard.yml packs the publishable group at a PR's own merge ref and diffs it against the pinned rc tag's already-packed tarballs, unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: publishedBytesBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Same #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule as rcBumpMarker. Remove once the pinned rcTag itself moves to the new rc (PR B, #1660).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: rc.6 prepare PR (founder-approved 2026-10-08): bunx changeset version bumps all four fixed-group members to 1.0.0-rc.6, consuming the adapter-path-render404-workaround.md and next-16-3-8-security.md changesets landed on main. Packed-tarball diff against the published 1.0.0-rc.5 tarballs confirms the only non-version deltas are the changes those changesets describe (the Next < 16.4.0 adapterPath render404 workaround: the internal standalone-adapter-path module and subpath export plus its build/deploy/preview wiring; the scaffold template next pins moving to 16.3.8 for GHSA-cjq9-62q9-8jv4) plus version-field and changelog updates. Remove this marker once the pinned rcTag itself moves to 1.0.0-rc.6 in a later PR, once that tag is actually pushed.
